page.content:
Baltimore man convicted of killing Hae Min Lee; Season 1's subject.

How Adnan Syed connects

  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Adnan Syed is the convicted man Season 1 investigates.
  • Character: Hae Min Lee — Adnan Syed was Hae Min Lee's ex-boyfriend and the man convicted of her murder.
  • Location: Woodlawn High School — Adnan Syed was a student at Woodlawn High School.
  • Location: Baltimore — Adnan Syed's case was tried in Baltimore.
  • Event: Adnan Syed conviction vacated — A 2022 Baltimore ruling vacated Adnan Syed's conviction.
  • Character: Jay Wilds — Jay Wilds testified that he helped Adnan after Hae's death.
  • Character: Asia McClain — Asia McClain's account was offered as an alibi for Adnan Syed.
  • Concept: cell-tower evidence — The state used cell-tower data to place Adnan Syed.

What is Adnan Syed?

Adnan Syed is the Woodlawn graduate Koenig interviews from prison, convicted of Hae Min Lee's 1999 murder, whose case Serial made famous and whose conviction was later vacated, then fought over again.

Key threads lead to Serial Season 1, Hae Min Lee, Woodlawn High School, Baltimore, Adnan Syed conviction vacated and Jay Wilds.
